html:
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

The details of Marvel Future Fight 3.3 have been finalized, and the update will be coming to your devices soon! The update will be bringing multiple changes to the game, extended Shadowlands and also providing a few other extras.


■3 New Characters

Absorbing Man, Titania and Spider-Man 2099 have been added.

Note:

Spider-Man 2099’s passive skill explanation:

Spider-Man 2099 will turn 75% transparent, as he gains an I-Frame for a short period (2 Seconds). As this is happening, a decoy will deploy and attack the enemy.

※Absorbing Man and Titania can be acquired in Biometrics Selectors.
※ Spider-Man 2099 is only available in the Get 20 biometrics dailypackage.

As new characters have been added, new Team Bonuses and Achievements are also added.

 

■3 New Uniforms added

New Uniforms for Yondu, Kid Kaiju, Spider-Gwen, and Thanos have been added.


※ New Uniforms will be available for a discounted price for a short period. You will be able to check the uniforms specific features in the Uniform Room.


■ Thanos Uniform Added

Thanos will be receiving a new uniform this update! This uniform will be set at a different price than other uniforms.

 

 

 ■Character Improvements

Captain America, Black Widow and Daredevil will all be receiving a makeover.

Captain America
Captain America will be receiving a small buff to his 3★ skill.


Black Widow
Black Widow will be receiving a small buff to her 3★ skill.

Daredevil
Daredevil will be getting a few small buffs to his skills this update.

 

 

■Shadowlands Improvements

Daredevil has finally settled on the changes to Shadowlands, and is finally unveiling his plans!

Shadowlands Expansion!

Shadowlands has now been expanded to 30 Floors! Face some of the most powerful foes in the game at the top of the tower!


 

※As Shadowlands has been increased to 30 floors, you will now need to clear all 30 floors in order to contest the King of the Hill mode!
※Shadowland will be available 08/11 01:00 (UTC+0) or 08/10 06:00PM (PDT).


A New Challenge: Entry Mode
Entry mode has been added to the list of possible modes that you can face in Shadowlands. The mode is similar to Alliance conquest, where you have to choose up to 6 characters in two teams and then engage in 3 on 3 combat! Unlike Alliance Conquest, you will have full control of your characters in this mode.



To win, you will need to wipe out the enemy team within the time limit. There are a possible 3 rounds to play!


New Rewards to Collect
From floor 26, you will be able to earn M’Kraan Crystals, Phoenix Feathers, [Information was changed on launch] and the all new ‘The Hand’s Chest’ or “Daredevils Chest”. These chests can give some amazing items for you to take away.

※You can check the content of the chests by pressing the inspect button at the bottom right of the image. This will show you all the possible items that you can get from the chest.


New Bonuses to earn
In addition to the existing rewards, if you complete a stage with 3 or more 6★ Characters you will take away extra rewards.




You can check the additional compensation by pressing the button on the lower left corner of the screen.
※If you complete the stage whilst satisfying the criteria, you will be rewarded with one bonus item!

Other Changes

1. Some Boss Mode stages have had their special objects modified.
EX) The Incense Burners on the Rocket Raccoon Stage have been modified.

2. As we have added a new stage type, the configuration of each floor has changed.


■World Boss Ultimate: Thanos Infinity Added.

The Ultimate challenge, Thanos Infinity has been added to World Boss Ultimate mode! Thanos has collected all the Infinity Stones, and has decided to take the training wheels off. Are you ready to defend the Universe against its greatest threat?



Now that Thanos (Infinity) has been added, the final World Boss Ultimate schedule has been completed.


※On Sundays, you will be able to select which of the World Bosses you would like to challenge.

 

■Alliance Changes
We have made a few quality of life changes for alliances!

Alliance Logs
A new Alliance Log has been added. This log will show when users are joining/leaving an alliance, donations received, Alliance Challenges etc. You can check all the information in the panel shown below!



New Conditions for joining an Alliance
You can now set a minimum S.H.I.E.L.D. Level for joining an alliance.


※Agents who have a lower level than the one set cannot join the alliance.
※You can change the conditions for joining an alliance every 24 hours.

Alliance Details
When looking at an Alliances Details, you can check what the Alliances current store level is.




Alliance Achievement Shortcuts added
New buttons have been added in the Alliance Achievement window which will allow you to go straight to the content that needs to be completed.




New Alliance Icons
A new X-Gene Alliance Icon has been added!

Alliance Bonus Effect Changes
Alliance Bonuses will now be applied to all content in the game, based on your Alliance level! 
※The Bonus effects will still increase according to the level of your Alliance.

■Hero Management Menu Improvements

To make it easier for you to manage your favorite heroes, we have made several changes to the hero management windows.

Hero Management UI Changes
The UI has been modified to make it easier to use.


-Information about the characters equipment can now be found in the Character Gear tab
-You can now view the character’s growth progress in the details window.
-A Character’s Custom Gear is available to see in the Custom Gear Window
-Character Usage tips can now be found in the Skills menu.

Sorting Improvement
You can now select any character to become your favorite characters. Favorite characters will appear at the front of the character selection list.



In addition to the new favorite tag, you can also sort the character selection by Level and Rank, in addition to the current Tier sorting.



New Equipment Options
There have been modifications to the way that gears work. Gears 1-3 will have 3 fixed stats, whilst gear 4 will have one optional stat. The third fixed stat for each character will be the following:


Gear 1: All Attacks Increases
Gear 2: All Defenses
Gear 3: HP

The numbers given for each of these stats is equivalent to high rolling every option. The amount you gain from each of the equipment slots will increase as the gear levels up.

Gear 4’s sub stat can be changed. It features the usual stats which were in slot 4, as well as 2 or 3 others which are recently added. You can check which stats you can roll for the fourth gear in the characters gear window!



ISO-8 Management Changes

Changes have been made to Chaotic ISO-8’s! You can now choose which ISO-8 you want to roll/combine, and the stats will be fixed based on the FIRST ISO-8 you select to combine. This means that you will now be able to control what the stats of your Chaotic ISO-8’s are.

 



We have also removed the level cap for unlocking ISO-8 slots. All characters will be able to use all 8 slots from level 1!


Detailed Window Improvement

If you have reached the cap for certain bonuses on your character, the numbers will display as yellow in the character details window.




 
■Challenge Content Changes

The Daily and Weekly Challenge panels have been combined. The new window will show different achievements that you need to complete each day, and as you complete those achievements, you will work towards your weekly Achievement! Complete 30 Daily Challenges and you will be able to claim the maximum weekly reward!



Other Challenge panels have also been simplified. The Character panel will include all challenges associated with your characters (Leveling up/Advancing to Tier-2). The Event Panel has been changed to the Forum panel, which includes rewards for making friends in game.

※Due to the update, Weekly challenges will be reset. If you do not collect your weekly rewards before the update, they will disappear.

■Other Improvements

1. Guide Quests have been modified
-Guide Quests will now allow you to receive rewards directly from the “Quest Complete” Dialogue
-Layout of the Quest popups have been improved
-Some tutorials and quests have been changed in Heroes Journey
-Some rewards in Hero’s Journey have been improved
-Players will no longer be able to start a Journey of Growth after the update
-Players will no longer be able to proceed through the Journey of Growth tutorial menus
-Players will no longer be able to start a Journey of Growth after the update
-Quests can be completed via the tutorial in Hero’s Growth

*Those who are currently in the process of completing Journey of Growth will still be able to complete the quest. 
*Heroes Journey will still remain

2. The tutorial stage has been improved.
3. Some of the loading screens in game have been changed.
4. Added a new graphic setting: Very Low.
-Very low reduces the resolution by 50%, and in game effects are removed or minimized as much as possible.
5. Comic Cards will now show their possible rolls, and the %’s gained for a cards level.
6. Comic Cards will now show you where they can attained

 


7. The UI of Co-op mode has been improved so that you can now see the number of rewards that can still be obtained.
8. The tooltip when using autoplay for the first time has been improved.
9. If you acquire enough biometrics to rank up a character from a mission, a new detailed information window will be displayed that will show you detailed stats for upgrading the character.
10. If there is currently no Character Ranking event, and you change the filter of the character list to show “Event heroes”, you will be shown a message saying that there are no Hero Ranking Events.
11. Cyclops second option on the ‘X-Band’ changed.
                Before: All Defenses
                After: Increased HP
12. If you have completed your daily entrance limit in Epic quest, you will still be shown a retry button so you can easily return to the mission ready window. However if you spend all your entries, and try to start the battle again. You will see a pop up telling you that you have no entries remaining.
13. If you are playing through a mission, and you acquire a new kind of item, a small description of what that item is for will show up.
14. You can now select how many Black Anti-matter you would like to fuse using the +/- buttons on the screen.

※This is only possible for fusing Black Anti-matter. Dismantling Black Anti-matter is not included.
15. If a character acquired from the package is available to be ranked up, a detailed stat window will show explaining the effects of the rank up.
16. Biometrics Selectors will now show more information about the character you currently have selected. It will display how many biometrics you currently have, as well as more of the character details.

17. In the ‘Status Board’ menu, ‘Veiled Secrets’ will now accurately show how many times you can enter the mode.
-If you have only unlocked ‘Magneto’s Might’ it will show that you can enter 2 times.
-If you have completed ‘Rise of The Phoenix’ it will display that you can enter 4 times.
18. World Boss Ultimate: Supergiant stage has been modified:
-Supergiant’s defense figures have been adjusted
-The value of the effects applied to summons has been adjusted according to Supergiant’s Defense
19. The following bugs from the 3.2 update have been fixed:
-When leveling up Native Tier-2 characters, biometrics will now be consumed normally.
-Changing notification settings via the in-game menus should now work correctly.
-Animations for character revives should now be fixed.
20.  Ancient One’s skill “Inner Self” now has a 75% transparency clarification. The skill will also give Ancient one a 10% Dodge boost.
21. Fixed an issue with Jean Grey’s “Phoenix Awaken” skill where if an enemy was being switched out, the skill would not work.
